name: Crown Towers Perth
insider_take: Perth's crown jewel sits majestically on the Swan River, where luxury meets the raw beauty of Western Australia's golden coastline.
whats_special: Crown Towers Perth boasts Australia's largest hotel lagoon pool spanning 2,000 square meters, complete with white sand beaches and cabanas. The hotel's Crystal Club floors offer exclusive access to panoramic views of the Swan River and Perth's glittering skyline. Located in Burswood, you're just minutes from Perth Stadium and the vibrant Crown Entertainment Complex.
pro_tip: Book a riverside suite during Perth's famous sunset hours - the Western Australian sky puts on a spectacular golden light show that's considered among the world's most beautiful.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool overlooking the Swan River, world-class dining at Nobu Perth, and easy access to Rottnest Island - home to the adorable quokka and just a 30-minute ferry ride away. The hotel's Crown Spa offers treatments using native Australian botanicals.
pros: Luxurious six-star accommodations with premium amenities
Prime location on the Swan River with stunning water views
Integrated resort experience with casino, dining, and entertainment
cons: Casino-integrated environment may not suit all guests
